additional_bounded_certification.purpose: rigorous compact-box objective upper bounds and branch-and-bound gap diagnostic, not global R^3 certificate
additional_bounded_certification.case_rule: first generated case per family and n, 12 cases
additional_bounded_certification.upper_bound_method: per-row logistic loglik supremum over eta range + half log determinant of maximum possible Fisher weights on each box
additional_bounded_certification.numerical_guarantee_limitation: mathematical enclosure only up to floating-point roundoff; no directed rounding; exploratory upper bound, not formally verified interval arithmetic

disposition: REFUSE if multiple distinct certified local maxima; single observed local maximum remains research-only and not globally certified
